Bill.BriefDescription: Providing tax exemptions for the purchase of books and other media by public libraries.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing tax exemptions for the purchase ofbooks and other media by public libraries; adding a new section tochapter 82.08 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; andproviding an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales ofbooks and other media purchased by a governmental unit that hasestablished a library. (2) This exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller must retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files. (3) For the purposes of this section, the following definitionsapply: (a) "Governmental unit" and "library" have the same meanings as inRCW 27.12.010. p. 1 HB 3352 (b) "Other media" includes phonograph records, compact discs,digital versatile discs or digital video discs, tapes, audio or videocassettes, periodicals, newspapers, and other printed or writtenmaterial available in a library.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to the useof books and other media by a governmental unit that has established alibrary. The definitions in section 1 of this act apply to thissection.
